title: Freelancer handover: twelve minutes before they disappear
lede: Twelve minutes is enough to find the SSH key, the orphan cron job, the file-ownership knot, and the mail alias the freelancer forgot to mention on her way out.
hero_alt: Overhead desk: handover checklist, manila KEYS folder, crontab strip, brass 12:00 plate, iron key, stopwatch, red wax seal.
